feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: NEA announces 2027 Jazz Masters class
entry.summary: The National Endowment for the Arts has named Terry Gibbs, Rufus Reid, Larry Ridley, Harvey Mason and John Edward Hasse as the newest musicians and advocates to receive the highest federal jazz honor.

entry.title: Tech stocks end the week on a down note, despite Anthropic's mega-IPO
entry.summary: The stock market is ending the week down despite Anthropic's blockbuster IPO and a strong Nvidia earnings report, largely thanks to investor jitters about the future of AI.

entry.title: New research gives insight to where your brain plans out your speech
entry.summary: New research shows where this all takes place and what it means for possibly treating those who have speech difficulties.

entry.title: The latest from Trump's press conference
entry.summary: President Trump gave a wide-ranging press conference following his historic trip to Asia where he met with Chinese President Xi and Russian President Putin.

entry.title: Climate talks are now in overtime
entry.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 countries have been meeting for two weeks to discuss steps to limit global warming.

entry.title: Going, going, gone: the tradition behind one ginkgo tree at Smith College
entry.summary: An ancient ginkgo tree on the Smith College campus dropped its leaves all at once, in a show of beauty and evanescence.

entry.title: Machine Gods: Anthropic's early days
entry.summary: In the wake of AI giant Anthropic's record-breaking IPO, Machine Gods hosts Kevin Roose and Casey Newton look back on the early days of the company, when less than 200 workers in a cramped office obsessed over AI safety and viewed business as an afterthought.

entry.title: Rising seas have forced this Quinault village to relocate
entry.summary: The Quinault Indian Nation has moved its largest village away from rising seas and tsunamis

entry.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
entry.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

entry.title: The Superbowl of Wheelchair Football pits the Kansas City Chiefs versus the Chicago Bears
entry.summary: They have the same name but they are different teams---The world champion Kansas City Chiefs are looking for a three-peat Saturday against the rival Chicago Bears in the "super bowl" of wheelchair football.
